ast.scope: Lexical source projection; no macro expansion or semantic resolution

cost.scope: The scope-specific cost statement within the invariant-and-cost document; no runtime speed measurement inferred.

obernants.scope: Leading whitespace before %! excludes that line. Error pattern removal excludes enforcing regex expectation during this extraction.
Output block admits any discarded ordinary source text and ignored directive blocks; shared prefixes may originate from many whitespace spellings.
Produced kind distinguishes Assert/Test/Error; no implementation evaluation or external file read in helper.
Unclosed function is not appended to funcs; unsupported directives are ignored. This finite lexical transform has no Result channel.
Input line order preserved; code is reconstructed with inserted newlines and shared variable empty initializers.
O(input bytes + emitted repeated shared/function prefixes), potentially amplified by block count.

coverage.description: Group %! lines by known directive; shared replaces initialization, completed function appends definition, assert/test/error append blocks with current prefixes. Error strips id= and angle-bracket pattern.
